Q: Extracting multiple occurrences from a string A:

You can handle this neatly using regular expressions in PHP instead of loops or manual parsing. A function like preg_match_all() will allow you to extract all quoted values after trigger: and store them directly in an array. This approach is clean, scalable, and works even if the number of occurrences varies.

Interestingly, just like how structured methods such as PRINCE2 Foundation and Practitioner help manage complex projects efficiently, using regex brings structure and clarity to string parsing tasks like this.

Q: Netty SSL: Chat Client example with custom keystore is unable to accept multiple connections A:

An SSLEngine object is a statefull object, it cannot be shared between multiple connections. Inside your server code, you are sharing this object between multiple connections, so the data the new client sends does not match the state on the server, causing weird cryptic errors.

Inside the initizer, change it to accept an SSLContext object, and call the create method manually

Q: How to call a web service using HttpWebRequest A:

I believe your only problem is the web server's configuration. Each web-service's configuration (web.config file in my case, since i'm using IIS) should allow the management of the protocols allowed to access it: Get, Post, and/or Soap.

I've just tested my own web-service and it replies to GET requests from my browser... It also answers as expected to POST requests ( I adapted some code from https://web.archive.org/web/20210619192654/https://www.4guysfromrolla.com/articles/022410-1.aspx into the following snippet: )

    Dim payload As Byte()
    payload = Text.Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes("paramName=firstValue&p2=secondValue")

    Dim webRequest As System.Net.HttpWebRequest
    webRequest = System.Net.HttpWebRequest.Create("http://www.servername.com/DataService.asmx/GetVersion")
    webRequest.Method = "POST"
    webRequest.KeepAlive = False
    webRequest.ContentType = "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
    webRequest.ContentLength = payload.Length

    Dim reqStream As System.IO.Stream
    reqStream = webRequest.GetRequestStream()
    reqStream.Write(payload, 0, payload.Length)
    reqStream.Close()

    Dim webResponse As System.Net.HttpWebResponse
    webResponse = webRequest.GetResponse()

    Dim reader As System.IO.StreamReader
    reader = New System.IO.StreamReader(webResponse.GetResponseStream())
    Dim xmlDoc As System.Xml.XmlDocument
    xmlDoc = New System.Xml.XmlDocument()
    xmlDoc.LoadXml(reader.ReadToEnd())

Good luck.
